title: Member Accounts Note: Kestrel Care Rewards Level and Late-Delivery Refunds (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The rewards level adjustment of a late-delivery refund on a Delivery & Pickup Services order depends on the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status.

## Adjustment

| Patient's active Kestrel Care Rewards level | Late-delivery refund |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | multiplied by 200 percent and rounded up to the cent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | multiplied by 150 percent and rounded up to the cent |
| any other level, or no active membership | kept as worked out |

The adjusted late-delivery refund is then limited to that speed fee: it is never more than the speed fee being refunded, and the refund is stated to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: express fee $6.99, refund worked out at 3.7746)

| Level | Adjustment | Limited to the $6.99 fee | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 3.7746 multiplied by 150 percent is 5.6619, rounded up to 5.67 | 5.67 is below 6.99 | $5.67 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 3.7746 multiplied by 200 percent is 7.5492, rounded up to 7.55 | limited to 6.99 | $6.99 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | kept at 3.7746 | below 6.99 | $3.77 |

"Rounded up to the cent" moves any fraction of a cent to the next whole cent: 5.6619 becomes 5.67, never 5.66.
